Heterotopic (ectopic) rest of cells
  • Choristoma is the term applied to a heterotopic (misplaced) rest of cells. For example, a small nodule of well-developed and normally organized pancreatic tissue may be found in the submucosa of the stomach, duodenum, or small intestine.
